stops.title: Device, Inverter, Layout
stops.body: The same architecture, three ways: a single transistor, the inverter it forms, and how it sits in a standard cell. Switch between them any time — the technology you're looking at carries across.

stops.title: Compare architectures
stops.body: FinFET, nanosheet, forksheet and CFET — the roadmap in order. Tap any chip to jump to it, or open Compare to see them side by side.

stops.title: Orbit, pan, zoom, inspect
stops.body: Drag with one finger to orbit. Two fingers to pan. Pinch to zoom. Tap any layer to see what it's made of.

stops.title: Views
stops.body: Jump straight to a framed angle — isometric, along the channel, across it — instead of hunting for it by hand.

stops.title: Section
stops.body: Slide to cut the model open on any axis, or pull the layers apart. Slow rotate and the other display switches live here too.

stops.title: Layers
stops.body: Hide any single layer to see what's underneath it — or hide a whole group, or everything, with one tap.

stops.title: Specs
stops.body: Critical dimensions, materials, and — on device scenes — the parasitic capacitances. Tap a row and the two conductors it couples light up on the model.

stops.title: Story
stops.body: The history behind this architecture. About, further back, has credits, source and where to report a bug.
